title: Add Heatmap Chart Mark

complexity.rationale: The rect-per-cell rendering directly reuses Bar's existing rect-mark construction pattern, just keyed by two ordinal (row/column) band scales instead of one ordinal + one linear scale. The only new pieces are a sequential color scale (a standard Vega scale type with no existing helper in this codebase yet, but no novel design needed to add one) and a hover scale-up encode (a straightforward size-on-hover transform, not previously used but mechanically simple).

summary: A row/column/value categorical grid mark rendering one rect per cell with a sequential color scale over value, and a hover scale-up (1.08x) effect.
requirements: Accepts `row`, `column` (both categorical/ordinal, required) and `value` (quantitative, required) channels
Renders one rect per row/column combination using two ordinal band scales
Cell fill color is driven by a sequential color scale over the value domain
Hovering a cell scales it up 1.08x in place, in addition to any existing hover/tooltip behavior

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Cells with no corresponding data row simply don't render (no forced zero-value rect), consistent with how other categorical marks handle sparse data.
Sequential scale domain collapses to a single value; all cells render the same color rather than dividing by a zero-width domain.
Band scale cell size shrinks per existing categorical-scale behavior; no minimum-cell-size enforcement in this spec.
Sequential color scale's range should be theme-aware, consistent with how other color scales already resolve against colorScheme.
S1-only for this spec; no S2 port until the mark stabilizes out of rc status.
Hover scale-up must not visually overlap/obscure adjacent cells' hit-targets in a way that breaks hovering a neighboring cell immediately after.

crossCutting.notes: touchesHoverAnimation: the 1.08x hover scale-up is a new encode.update rule gated on the existing hover signal pattern, applied to size/transform rather than opacity/color as most existing hover encodes do. touchesTooltipOrPopover: cells support ChartTooltip/ChartPopover showing row/column/value, reusing existing interactive-mark plumbing. requiresNewSignalOrScale: true — a new sequential color scale type (no existing helper in scaleUtils.ts/scaleSpecBuilder.ts; shared groundwork with add-contour-mark and add-xy-heatmap-mark, though each gets its own scale instance). requiresS1S2Parity: false because this ships as a new s1-only rc-status mark, matching the Donut/BigNumber precedent; revisit once promoted out of rc.
